purpose: Test whether a causal Fibonacci retracement overlay improves setup quality for already-frozen ENA mean-reversion and HTF trend candidates without changing either forward candidate. Separate generic pullback-depth filtering from Fibonacci-specific proximity by retaining a matched non-Fibonacci control.

data.source: MEXC public futures klines plus observed public realized funding where required
data.missing_funding_rule: Funding-aware HTF tests must stop rather than impute unavailable pre-coverage funding as zero.

fibonacci_definition.anchor_rule: For a long setup, use the lowest prior low in the lookback and the highest subsequent prior high after that low. For a short setup, use the highest prior high and the lowest subsequent prior low after that high. Both anchor points must therefore already exist before the signal close.

baseline.description: Original frozen candidate with no Fibonacci entry gate.

fib_core.description: Permit a new entry or reversal only when retracement depth is within +/-2.5 percentage points of 38.2%, 50%, or 61.8%.

fib_deep_786.description: Permit a new entry or reversal only when retracement depth is within +/-2.5 percentage points of 78.6%.

nonfib_matched_control.description: Matched three-level pullback-depth control using identical tolerance but deliberately non-Fibonacci centers.

ena_mean_reversion.entry_gate_rule: The Fib overlay may block a new entry or direction reversal, but once admitted it cannot alter the original signal-state exit or the frozen ATR stop.

htf_trend.entry_gate_rule: The Fib overlay may block a transition from flat into a new trend side or a direct reversal. Once admitted, the position remains until the original EMA/ATR target exits, goes flat, or reverses; an unqualified reversal exits the old side and waits flat.

cross_sectional_candidate.reason: A dollar-neutral cross-sectional rank has no single directionally coherent swing anchor. Adding a BTC-level Fib gate or arbitrary per-asset anchor would change the methodology rather than add a like-for-like setup filter.
